notes.title: Update Rise of the ShieldMancer
Shield Update Devlog
notes.notes:
Shield Update Devlog

On this second part of the new update for TowerMancer we will add a new mechanic to the game, SHIELDS!


- ShieldMancer
A new sister will be added to the game, bringing with her shields for your tower. She is the royal guard of the LichMancer and is here to help the family;

- Movement
The tower will now have two shields, one in each side of the tower. You can move them by dragging to the desired floor. Although they are a little slow they can defend your rooms against threats;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173704/57d9cb7ba08cf488fd12e5ae6423bdf4c68ff387.gif

- Defense
When on the same floor that a threat will hit, the shield can take up that hit, being broken in the process. It is possible to repair it as you already do with rooms;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173704/618936a21fbf10000f2ffdb74e7a353663a4cf1e.gif

- Upgrades
Each sibling will give a different upgrade to your shield can you guess what each does?

This new mechanic will help the player to have more control against threats and we hope that this solve some issues pointed out by you. We loved to play with this new addition and hope that you all do to!

This update is coming soon, stay tuned!

If you have any doubts, suggestions or wanna be closer of the project development join the TowerMancer Discord: https://discord.gg/gQnDNccHBy


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173704/db854e22fe0785902f2ca69ce793c1db39d1c252.png

notes.title: Update Imp Justice
Rogue Update Devlog
notes.notes:
As part of the new update for TowerMancer we are reworking how the Rogues and Mages work.

Rogue
After entering a room, Rogues will take some seconds to steal resources;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173704/a2e075f74f3da2f6680b4cca5cbf89237d5c494c.gif

Mage
After entering a room, the Mage will take some seconds to revert it back to a basic room;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173704/b84ef861cd26b01cbee615c0a2af675c2e412321.gif

Imps
Now you can use an Imp to fight off a Mage/Rogue that is invading a room. Each Imp can prevent one threat, taking a few seconds to do so;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173704/f019fbb3b063afd6d214705847f2c617a42040ad.gif

Room Alert
A room that is being invaded by a Rogue/Mage will display a warning sign, prompting the player that an Imp can be dropped on it to fight the threat;

New Tutorial stage
We will add a new stage that explains the player how this new Imp vs Threat interaction works;
This is a part one of the new patch we are working on. As soon as we have more info to share we will make another announcement. Stay tuned!

We hope that this patch can solve the issue that players don't have a way to fight back threats, other than just keep reparing destroyed rooms.

If you have any doubts, suggestions or wanna be closer of the project development join the TowerMancer Discord: https://discord.gg/gQnDNccHBy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173704/a35fbfc9bedd5fc67b7746e95f5749990532b2d2.png

notes.title: TowerMancer Demo Update!
notes.notes:
- Full Demo potential unleashed!
For those who want to see a TowerMancer full potential, we've included all rooms and threats on the demo. Give it a try and let us know what you think! They'll be progressively unlocked throughout the levels.

If you enjoy the game, please leave your review! It makes us really happy to see your feedback!

notes.title: Pre Launch small update (2021-02-22)
notes.notes:
Check out these updates for the TowerMancer!

What's new:
[olist]
 Windowed Mode
  Now it is possible to play TowerMancer in all it's glory in a window! Be it big, small or tiny. Window Mode is a reality!

 Imps behavior
  Imps now practice social distancing. While working on a room Imps avoid the mouse and each other! No more rebel imps interrupting your work.
[/olist]
